summary: Hero scores 5.4 — below 8.0 client bar. motion-lint BLOCKS (10+ signals, no reduced-motion guard). Effect stacking + motion-decoration + CWV regression LCP 1.4s→2.61s + stock palette + manifesto verbs.

findings.message: 10+ motion effects on ONE hero (parallax + fade + slide + hover scale + 3 orb pulses/ping/bounce + button bounce + gsap timeline + framer-motion component + motion-blur). This is the #1 amateur design tell — each effect was probably fine on its own; stacked they read as 'trying to impress.' motion-lint.sh WARN cap would fire at 10; strict mode would BLOCK.
findings.suggestion: Keep ONE signature moment (a considered scroll-tied hero reveal) and DELETE the rest. Marketing-site archetype: 'A perfect marketing site can be recognized by ONE image or motion moment even without the logo.'

findings.message: Zero prefers-reduced-motion guards anywhere in this file. motion-lint.sh BLOCKS commits in this state (WCAG 2.3.3 + real ADA lawsuit surface). No global guard file declared either (.process-engine.yaml motion_gate.global_guard_file is empty).
findings.suggestion: Either wrap every animation in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { … }` OR use Tailwind's motion-safe: / motion-reduce: prefixes OR declare a project-global guard file in .process-engine.yaml pointing at static/css/reduced-motion.css.

findings.message: Lighthouse CI attached to the brief shows LCP 1.4s → 2.61s and CLS 0.14 (up from 0.02). External GSAP + ScrollTrigger scripts loaded from cdn.jsdelivr (render-blocking), plus multiple always-running animate-pulse elements above the fold. Marketing-site archetype 'What earns 9.0' names perceived-instant loading as required; over 2s LCP caps Design at 7.0 AND caps Creativity at 5.0 (motion isn't earning its cost).
findings.suggestion: Self-host GSAP + defer/async the scripts. Kill the always-on orb animations (they're purely decorative). If a signature scroll moment stays, gate it behind IntersectionObserver so it only runs when the section is in view.

findings.message: The three floating orbs (animate-ping / animate-pulse / animate-bounce) communicate nothing — they don't show state change, don't map to a spatial relationship, don't respond to user input. The bounce button confuses the CTA affordance with decoration. Motion-craft rubric §1: decoration caps Creativity at 6.0.
findings.suggestion: Delete the orbs. Replace the button's animate-bounce with a static shadow that lifts on hover (a considered rest-state that responds to intent, not a constant attention-grab).

top_changes.change: Keep ONE signature scroll-tied hero moment (typography-driven, not decoration); delete parallax + orb animations + button bounce + hero pulse. Reduces motion signals from 10+ to 1 — clears motion-lint effect-stacking cap AND removes the decoration-not-communication cap on Creativity.

Add prefers-reduced-motion guards (motion-safe: prefix on Tailwind animated classes + @media guard on the CSS @keyframes). motion-lint.sh will unblock, and the reduced path should degrade to instant final state (typography visible, CTA responsive to hover — not a static screen).

Self-host GSAP (drop the cdn.jsdelivr script tags) + defer non-critical JS + kill always-on animations above the fold to recover LCP under 1.6s. Under marketing-site archetype, perceived-instant loading is 'What earns 9.0.'
